### 2026-10-17 – Entry - 1

**10.5h**

Entry - 1
Merbl project

Hi guys, I know I should have already taken my video before I did this much work on this project. I had a fever one day, and I couldn't really take videos, but I did most of the work. I started from scratch I didn't know anything about 3D modelling. Onshape was a different kind of experience, and it was really hard and time-consuming overall it was a tough nut to crack. When I started, I didn't even know how to create a student account, so I made a normal one and started to work on it. With the help of the Merbl guide and YouTube videos, I've made a lot of progress, and I'm happy about it
